substrate.performance_target_only: 10^5+ entities; no FPS claim until benchmarked

lambda_0_sweep.interpretation: candidate influx control parameter; ignition and extinction thresholds are measured outcomes

entity_lifecycle.note: coherence/lifecycle gates determine persistence eligibility but do not by themselves certify agency

agency_certificate.definition: paired counterfactual pruning of reachable future volume in the fixed-dimensional entity macrostate

macrostate.normalization: per-coordinate center and scale fitted on calibration_seeds only, then frozen

agency_certificate.controlled_condition: V_controlled,h from q_A rollouts under step(members, some(control), xi)
agency_certificate.free_condition: V_free,h from q_A rollouts under step(members, none, xi)

confidence.method: paired bootstrap over matched rollout indices, recomputing both covariance log-determinants
confidence.primary_success_rule: lower confidence bound for DeltaV at the primary horizon > 0.10 nats

power_and_precision_gate.rule: calibration-only estimator study must satisfy both CI half-width and rollout/dimension gates; otherwise v1 is RED and any change to d, M, epsilon, effect threshold, or estimator requires run_spec_v2 before confirmatory outcomes are inspected

agency_certificate.crystal_guard: future-volume contraction certifies causal control only; persistent agency additionally requires lifecycle viability, positive resource balance, nontrivial throughput, and action-cost accounting

H1_recursive_control.claim: recursive control produces preregistered persistence/hierarchy effects beyond passive, detection-only, and shallow-control universes

H2_connectome_topology.claim: MaleCNS topology differs from topology-destroying and matched synthetic controller controls under identical interfaces and charged budgets
H2_connectome_topology.primary_budget_rule: matched topology controllers pay the same reserved compute charge per controller invocation and share the same action-energy ceiling; cheaper implementation runtime cannot create a metabolic advantage in H2
H2_connectome_topology.efficiency_secondary_measure: actual normalized operation count and wall-clock cost are recorded per instance but are not allowed to alter the primary H2 energy charge

split_world.shock: standardized momentum impulse J_shock selected only by the frozen calibration procedure

stress_calibration.selection_rule: choose the smallest candidate magnitude whose severed-branch death fraction falls in [0.20, 0.40]; freeze it before confirmatory runs
stress_calibration.failure_rule: if no candidate magnitude enters the target band, v1 remains RED and the grid may change only in run_spec_v2
stress_calibration.purpose: ensure the intervention battery reaches the viability boundary rather than testing only gentle perturbations

intervention_battery: momentum impulses in +x, -x, +y, -y at the frozen boundary-stress magnitude
phase reset of 10 percent of immediate constituents
signature.representation: concatenated calibration-normalized q_A response trajectory over the frozen intervention battery
signature.distance: normalized Frobenius distance between response matrices
signature.epsilon_calibration: 95th percentile of within-entity repeated-intervention distances on calibration_seeds only; value frozen before confirmatory turnover runs

closed_passive_limit_conservation_checks: energy where the chosen passive integrator/force law implies conservation
linear momentum where boundary conditions and force law imply conservation
symmetry/invariance checks appropriate to the passive dynamics

claims_boundary.v1_scale_claim: recursive scale-consistency across simulator-defined discrete levels
explicitly_not_claimed: automatic discovery of physically privileged coarse-graining scales
claims_boundary.deferred_experiment: search over continuous or overlapping coarse-grainings with agency certification used to discover candidate causal boundaries

failure_modes_are_independent: no statistically resolved counterfactual future-volume pruning
no recursive advantage over shallow control
no causal-signature continuity after full turnover
